correctOnly.title: You decide scan corrections from Today
correctOnly.body: Your role decides the floor's corrections one at a time, from Today. The queue, the line days and the changes on this page take “production.labour.view”.

noAccess.title: Your role cannot see Labour & corrections

legal.label: Legal basis
legal.BASIS: Pay records under L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.1: {basis} {reference}, recorded {when} by {name}. One person at a time; views are logged.
legal.BASIS_noName: Pay records under L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.1: {basis} {reference}, recorded {when}. One person at a time; views are logged.
legal.ON: Pay records under L. 300/1970 art. 4 c.1: this site's legal basis is in force. One person at a time; views are logged.
legal.GATE_OFF: Per-person sheets are off on this site: its legal basis for one person's work figures is not in force. Records say where and what, never who.
legal.STATION: Per-person sheets are off on this site: it records stations, not people.
legal.UNKNOWN: This site's legal basis could not be read: no person's sheet opens until it can.
legal.who: The worker and HR see one person's day
legal.whoLeads: The worker, HR and the worker's team lead see one person's day
legal.whoGATE_OFF: Nobody opens one person's sheet here
legal.whoSTATION: Only line days and station corrections remain
legal.lawPlain: Equipment that could also watch workers needs a union agreement or an authorisation from the labour inspectorate, and workers must be told first. Pay records of one person are shown only on that basis, one person at a time, and every opening is written down.

who.named: This record is {name}'s: named here because the site's legal basis is in force.
who.hidden: A person is on this record. Their name shows only where the site's legal basis is in force.

what.day: Everything coded and cleared: ready to close

queue.label: To decide
queue.title: To decide
queue.failed: The queue could not be read

noMatch.title: Nothing here matches
noMatch.body: Clear the filters to see the whole queue.

empty.title: Nothing to decide ✓
empty.body: Corrections, disputes, off-standard blocks and line days to close land here.

keys.title: Keys
keys.reject: Reject the item, with a reason

held.busy: One moment: the last decision is being saved.
held.noDayPicked: No line day ready to close is selected.
held.tooMany: This is the most one list shows: narrow it by line or kind.
held.dayHeld: Something still holds this day: see what, here.
held.ownDispute: This dispute is about your own record: another person answers it.
held.ownBlock: This is your own time: another person decides it.
held.dayNoReject: A line day is closed or left open: there is nothing to reject.
held.notClosed: Only a closed day is reopened.
held.reasonShort: Write a little more: at least three letters.
held.sheetsOff: Per-person sheets are off on this site.
held.noEmployee: This person has no employee record: no sheet to open.
held.noFigures: One person's day is opened only by the worker, by HR and, where the site allows it, by the worker's team lead.
held.sheetReason: Say why you open this person's day.
held.noPayroll: People › Payroll export is not built yet.

select.oneByOne: Decided on its own: open it.

days.title: Line days
days.hint: Close each line's day once off-standard time is coded and anomalies are cleared; closed days feed pay.
days.failed: The line days could not be read

empty.title: No line days in these dates
empty.body: A day shows once something happened on the line.

edits.title: Changes to labour records
edits.hint: Every edit keeps before and after, who, when and why.
edits.named: a person is on this record

empty.title: No changes in these dates
empty.body: Every change to a labour record lands here.

detail.notFound: This item is gone, or belongs to a site you cannot reach.
detail.earnedHint: Good pieces × the operation's standard minutes.
detail.noChange: The counts asked are the same as those recorded.
detail.appendOnly: Approve adds a correction row; nothing is overwritten.
detail.recordGone: The record could not be read.
detail.rights: A worker may see and dispute their own records at any time (GDPR arts. 15-16).
detail.nothingHolds: Nothing holds it: it can be closed.

source.FLOOR: On the floor, as it happened

reject.title: Reject
reject.reasonHint: Sent to the person as you write it.

body.CORRECTION: The report stays as it was recorded. The person sees why.
body.OFF_STANDARD: The block stays on the record as rejected and pays nothing. The person sees why.

answer.title: Answer the dispute
answer.wordsHint: Sent to the person as you write it.
answer.reportHint: An upheld answer changes no count: a report changes through its correction, which the worker asks and a lead approves.
answer.blockHint: Upheld, the block can be corrected in this step: its change is written down with this dispute.

close.title: Close the day for {line}
close.body: Closed days feed pay; reopening needs permission and a reason.

reopen.title: Reopen the day for {line}
reopen.body: {day}. Its blocks and disputes take changes again, and pay reads it again once it is closed.

find.title: Open a person's day
find.body: One person, one day. Their name stays in this dialog; opening their day is logged.
find.name: Name or employee code
find.none: Nobody by that name at this site.

sheet.title: Daily sheet
sheet.logged: This view is logged: who opened it, when and why are recorded and visible to HR and the data protection officer. No comparison with others, no export, no print.
sheet.noAttendance: Not shown: this site's attendance purpose is off (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4 c.2).

refusal.NOT_YET: This day has not come yet: close a day once its work is done.
refusal.HELD: Something still holds this day: it stays open until that is dealt with.
refusal.DAY_CLOSED: The day is closed (closed days feed pay): reopen it with a reason first.
refusal.STATION_SITE: This site records stations: it has no personal records.
refusal.DISPUTE_NOT_OPEN: This dispute was answered or withdrawn already.
refusal.OWN_DISPUTE: This dispute is about your own record: another person answers it.
refusal.BLOCK_RUNNING: The block is still running: its times are corrected once it ended.
refusal.STILL_RUNNING: The block is still running: it is decided once it ended.
refusal.OWN_TIME: This is your own time: another person decides it.
refusal.OVERLAPS: Those times overlap another block of the same person or station.
refusal.CODE_INACTIVE: That code is not in use any more.
refusal.SELF_APPROVAL: You took this scan or asked its correction: another person decides it.
refusal.TARGET_VOIDED: The scan it corrects was undone or corrected since: reject it, and the floor asks again.
refusal.GATE: Per-person sheets are off on this site.
refusal.FIGURES: One person's day is opened only by the worker, by HR and, where the site allows it, by the worker's team lead.
refusal.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: The work order is not open any more: its reports do not change.
refusal.PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED: The operation before this one has not passed this bundle yet: report it first.
refusal.MORE_THAN_BUNDLE: These counts are more than the bundle carries.
refusal.MORE_THAN_PASSED: These counts are more than the operation before passed on.
refusal.LESS_THAN_TAKEN: These counts are less than the next operation already took.
refusal.NO_COUNT: A report needs at least one piece.
refusal.UNKNOWN_SCAN: The scan it corrects is gone.
refusal.SAME_COUNTS: These counts are the same as the report's.
refusal.NEXT_REPORTED: The next operation took this bundle already.
refusal.ON_HOLD: The bundle or its work order is on hold: this waits for its release.

problem.read: This could not be read. Try again.
problem.write: This did not go through. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone else changed this meanwhile: read it again and decide.
problem.refused: The rule refused this: read it again.
problem.gone: This is gone, or belongs to a site you cannot reach.
problem.invalid: Something in this is not valid: check it and try again.

notice.corrected: Correction approved: a correction row was added, nothing overwritten.
notice.refused: Correction refused: the report stands as recorded.
notice.upheldCorrected: Dispute upheld and the block corrected.
notice.skippedOther: {code}: left out (it changed, it is your own time, or its day is closed).
notice.leftOut_one: {count} unusual block stays to decide on its own.
notice.leftOut_other: {count} unusual blocks stay to decide one by one.
